turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it bad to drink coffee in the afternoon?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a lot of people, yes. Caffeine can stay in your system for six hours or more, so a cup at four can still keep you up at ten.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, wow. What about tea?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Black and green tea have less caffeine, but still some. Herbal teas like chamomile or mint have none.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: something around three to get through work.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try a short walk outside or a glass of cold water instead. A little daylight and movement can wake you up surprisingly well.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll give it a shot tomorrow.
